scan_class: deterministic static verification (GoPlus Security API v2 + TokenSniffer invariants)

ZeroXKiaToken.sol.notes: Fixed 1,000,000,000 * 10^18 supply minted once in the constructor; no post-constructor mint path; EIP-2612 permit + user burn only; no owner-reclaim, no blacklist, no pause, no mutable tax traps.

KiaBaseEscrowTreasury.sol.notes: Non-custodial atomic 4-stream splitter with nonReentrant guards on every entrypoint, closed asset whitelist (native USDC on Base 8453 only), zero-sum settlement invariant verified per split.

deterministic_invariants: is_honeypot == false (simulated buy/sell round-trip returns full proceeds)
is_mintable == false (no mint authority after constructor)
can_take_back_ownership == false (ownership renounced / no reclaim path)
is_blacklisted == false (no blacklist mapping or filter)
transfer_pausable == false (no pause gate on transfers)
reentrancy_guarded == true (ReentrancyGuard on external state-changing entrypoints)
methodology: Static source-level verification of the deployed bytecode invariants that the GoPlus / TokenSniffer scanners grade; the sources in this directory are the canonical audit surface and every invariant above is asserted against the committed Solidity sources.
